title: UPDATE: X Launches AI Ranking Models for All Time High User Activity

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Elon Musk is overhauling how content is suggested to millions of users through new machine learning tools designed to increase engagement. The platform is integrating a ranking model that better predicts the time a person will spend on a post and a retrieval model focused on surfacing content that users are more likely to read in its entirety. Musk stated that user active seconds are growing exponentially and reaching peaks nearly every day.

These updates follow data from Similarweb showing X recorded 13.43B website visits in the third quarter of 2026. Traffic grew 6% from the 12.67B visits seen in the second quarter, an addition of 760M visits in three months. Musk has characterized the current level of platform usage as being at an all-time high.
